caseName: Ohio ex rel. Hawke v. LeBlond
caseNameFull: State of Ohio Ex rel. George S. Hawke v. Robert A. LeBlond, as Presiding Judge, etc.
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Ohio.
attorneys: Mr George S. Hawke for plaintiff in error. Mr. Robert A. Le- ; Blond for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to advance is denied. The application for certiorari is also denied, and the writ of error is dismissed by the Court of its own motion, upon authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726.
